claims.claim: Researchers at the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian built Lumina, one of the largest simulations yet of the early universe.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian built Lumina, one of the largest simulations yet of the early universe, to match data from the James Webb Space Telescope and the upcoming Nancy Roman Space Telescope.
claims.source_title: Lumina simulation brings the early universe to life on a record-breaking scale
claims.supporting_quote: To help astronomers understand what they are seeing, researchers at the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian have developed "Lumina," one of the largest and most detailed simulations ever created of the early universe.
